title: Separate the errors
story: score_all.sh prints a score for each of 8 designs, but some score files are missing, and the errors get mixed in with the scores. Run it with the errors sent to errors.log, then report how many designs did get a score.

~/{{project}}/score_all.sh.content:
#!/bin/bash
for d in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08
do
  cat scores/design_$d.sc
done

tasks.text: Run it with errors going to errors.log
Report how many designs got a score

hints: `2>` redirects error messages, the same way `>` redirects normal output. `./score_all.sh 2> errors.log`
